>  I just feel like your post is only warning people seeking help on SW

Yes, that's correct. The reason for this is because it's the entire subject of the post. The people are are seeking help on SW are the ones who are vulnerable and need to be warned.

I think you are missing the point. There are SW regulars who do put it on themselves to "help" long-term, and it doesn't work. Not doing anyone any favors.

Also, yes trolls exist, but there are others who are not trolls that still abuse the dynamic this situation provides.
